merge_state_merge: merge prefix and suffix attention outputs with log-sum-exp values into a combined output tensor
merge_state_fallback: fallback to a Triton kernel when CUDA or supported dtype conditions are not met
merge_state_supported_dtypes: check whether a tensor dtype is supported by the merge state kernel
merge_state_supported_headdim: check whether a tensor's head dimension is aligned for the target dtype
merge_state_select_kernel: select the optimal merge state kernel based on hardware and tensor properties
